# #93 — P1: Enforce namespace predicates on ID-based mutating tools

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-06-11T02:42:51Z
Updated: 2026-06-11T03:39:02Z
Closed: 2026-06-11T03:39:02Z

---

## Finding
Several ID-based mutating tools authorize by role/table, then update or archive rows by UUID without checking that the target row is in the caller's readable/writable namespace.

## Evidence
- `src/tools/update-entry.ts:129` checks only `canWrite(auth.role, table)`, then `src/tools/update-entry.ts:171` selects by `id` only and `src/tools/update-entry.ts:283` updates by `id` only.
- `src/tools/set-tier.ts:42` checks only table write permission, then `src/tools/set-tier.ts:56` updates by `id` only.
- `src/tools/rate-entry.ts:42` checks only table write permission, then `src/tools/rate-entry.ts:56` updates by `id` only.
- `src/tools/bulk-set-tier.ts:64` checks table permissions for all entries, then `src/tools/bulk-set-tier.ts:89` updates each row by `id` only.
- `src/tools/archive-entry.ts:35` and `src/tools/bulk-archive.ts:60` check delete permission, but `src/tools/archive-entry.ts:51` and `src/tools/bulk-archive.ts:82` archive by `id` only.
- `src/tools/curate-entries.ts:161`, `src/tools/curate-entries.ts:200`, and `src/tools/curate-entries.ts:232` scan across whole tables with no namespace filter; the destructive path at `src/tools/curate-entries.ts:181` and `src/tools/curate-entries.ts:214` archives by `id` only.

## Risk
Any caller with a valid role for a table can mutate another namespace's row if they learn or receive a UUID from logs, links, prior broad access, or operator copy/paste. This breaks the namespace isolation model that `log_*`, `session_*`, search, and read APIs now enforce.

Delegated header sessions are also affected: an admin or n8n token scoped with `X-Namespace` can still mutate rows outside that effective namespace through ID-only tools.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add a shared helper for ID-based namespace predicates, or equivalent per-tool logic, that respects:
  - token-sourced admin/n8n broad access when no `X-Namespace` delegation is active
  - delegated `X-Namespace` scope for all roles
  - ordinary agent/readonly/discord namespace limits
- Apply the namespace predicate to `update_entry`, `set_tier`, `rate_entry`, `archive_entry`, `bulk_set_tier`, `bulk_archive`, and destructive `curate_entries` paths.
- Ensure duplicate/collision checks are namespace-aware where uniqueness is namespace-scoped.
- Add tests proving an agent cannot mutate another namespace by UUID.
- Add tests proving delegated admin/n8n cannot mutate outside the delegated namespace.
- Keep token-sourced admin/n8n behavior broad where that is the intended operational model.
